// Fixture text, never compiled. Shape of the leak in heardright#292: a pool-less polling thread.
use objc2_app_kit::{NSRunningApplication, NSWorkspace};
use std::sync::mpsc::Sender;
use std::time::Duration;

pub fn start_frontmost_poll(tx: Sender<FrontApp>) {
    std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("frontmost-poll".into())
        .spawn(move || {
            loop {
                let workspace = NSWorkspace::sharedWorkspace();
                if let Some(app) = workspace.frontmostApplication() {
                    let _ = tx.send(FrontApp::from_running(&app));
                }
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250));
            }
        })
        .expect("spawn frontmost poll");
}
